zh.text: 美股盤前延續下跌（SPX -0.3%，NDX -0.3%），因今晚 $NVDA 業績和 Anthropic IPO。布倫特原油升至93美元/桶，10年期美債收益率回落至5.10%。比特幣跌至6.43萬美元，金銀小幅上漲。$NVDA 跌0.4%但成立國家安全監督委員會。市場定價12月美聯儲加息概率超100%，因近期經濟數據強勁，2027年可能減息。標普2026年EPS估計369美元（同比+33%）意味20.1倍市盈率。

en.text: US stocks extended pre-market declines (SPX -0.3%, NDX -0.3%) ahead of tonight’s $NVDA earnings and Anthropic IPO. Brent crude rose to $93/bbl, 10-year yield eased to 5.10%. Bitcoin dropped to $64.3K, gold and silver rose modestly. $NVDA slipped 0.4% but created a national security oversight committee. Markets price >100% chance of December Fed rate hike on strong data, potential cuts in 2027. S&P 2026 EPS estimates $369 (+33% YoY) imply 20.1x P/E.

zh.text: T. Rowe堅持看淡國債的押注，推動了出色的2026年。自2026年初押注英國金邊債券並做空美國國債，為T. Rowe Price的Scott Solomon帶來回報，他不急於平倉這些押注。他共同管理的8億美元Dynamic Global Bond Fund今年迄今上漲約5%，跑贏97%同行，有望創2020年以來最佳年度表現。支撑這一回報的基本信念是：美國經濟將繼續超越其他經濟體，給國債帶來壓力。「我們堅持美國強勁增長、世界其他地區增長不那麼好的觀點，」Solomon說。

en.text: T. Rowe Sticks to Bearish Treasuries Bet That Fueled Banner 2026. Betting on UK gilts and against US Treasuries since early 2026 is paying off for T. Rowe Price’s Scott Solomon, who isn’t in any hurry to unwind those wagers. His co-managed $800 million Dynamic Global Bond Fund is up around 5% so far this year, beating 97% of peers and on track for its best annual performance since 2020. Underpinning that return was a basic conviction: That the US economy would keep outpacing other economies, putting pressure on Treasuries. “We’ve stuck with the view of strong growth in the US and not quite as good growth in the rest of the world,” Solomon said.

zh.text: 突發：駭客向至少178家主要組織運營的網站傳播惡意軟件，包括Zoom、CNN、BBC、Fox News、HSBC、Equifax、Salesforce、IKEA和Air France-KLM，據安全公司Report URI。攻擊者利用網站測試平台Optimizely的漏洞植入旨在竊取支付數據、劫持加密支付並針對較舊 iPhone的代碼。銀行和金融受創最重，32家組織受影響，包括多個市場的HSBC。Optimizely表示漏洞已修復。Report URI目前追蹤到約7000美元被盜加密貨幣。

en.text: BREAKING: Hackers spread malware to websites run by at least 178 major organizations, including Zoom, CNN, BBC, Fox News, HSBC, Equifax, Salesforce, IKEA and Air France-KLM, per security firm Report URI. Attackers exploited a flaw in Optimizely, a website-testing platform, to plant code designed to steal payment data, hijack crypto payments and target older iPhones. Banking and finance was hit hardest, with 32 organizations affected, including HSBC across multiple markets. Optimizely says the flaw is fixed. Report URI has traced about $7,000 in stolen crypto so far.
